    Recording, mixing and mastering in Warsaw

    Sanctum Sound offers vocal recording in Warsaw, along with instrument and band sessions, mixing, mastering and full music production — all under one roof in Praga-Południe. A sound engineer runs every session, you get full access to the studio gear, and you leave with digital files of your recordings. Sessions start at 120 PLN per hour.

    Vocal Recording

    Vocal recording in a studio equipped with modern gear. We record for music tracks, rap, podcasts, commercials, and more. With us, you can expect clear sound, a comfortable atmosphere, and an individual approach that lets you fully unlock the potential of your voice

    Instrument Recording

    Professional recordings of musical instruments in perfectly prepared acoustic conditions. We record guitars, bass, drums, keyboard, string, and wind instruments, ensuring the highest sound quality. We have top-tier equipment and microphones from brands such as Audix, Shure, Behringer, AKG, and Sennheiser, guaranteeing natural, detailed sound ready for mixing and mastering

    Mixing & Mastering

    Professional mixing and mastering. We ensure the right balance, dynamics, and space in the recording so your music sounds great on all platforms and playback systems. Every project is treated individually, highlighting its character and potential. We also offer vocal editing, drum alignment, and more

    Audio Production

    Have a song idea but do not know how to turn it into a professional track? We offer comprehensive music production from the first concept to the final material ready for release. We help develop arrangements, record vocals and instruments, and then handle editing, mixing, and mastering

    Vocal and rap recording

    Whether you sing, rap or speak, the vocal booth is where most sessions begin. We record vocals for songs, verses and hooks, as well as voice work for podcasts and adverts. If you’re after a rap recording studio in Warsaw where the engineer gets doubles, ad-libs and punch-ins, bring your beat and we’ll get the takes down efficiently.

    We work with microphones from Audix, Shure, AKG, Sennheiser and Behringer and choose the one that suits your voice. Vocal editing and tuning are available, so the final take sounds tight without losing its character.

    Band and instrument recording

    As a band recording studio in Warsaw, we track guitars, bass, drums, keys, strings and wind instruments. Guitarists can play through Marshall, Randall, Peavey and Blackstar amps; bassists can plug into Darkglass or Warwick. Drum editing is available, so the groove locks in before the mix.

    Come with a finished song or a rough demo — we’ll plan the session with you so your studio time goes into playing rather than setting up.

    Mixing and mastering

    Our mixing and mastering in Warsaw starts at 400 PLN per song. Editing and unlimited revisions are included, and we’ll help you get the finished track ready for release. We balance levels, dynamics and space so your music holds up on headphones, car speakers and big systems alike.

    Music production and arrangement

    Got an idea but no finished track? Working with a music producer in Warsaw can take it from a voice memo to a song you can release. We help shape the arrangement, record vocals and instruments, then edit, mix and master the result — one team from start to finish.

    How much does it cost to record a song?

    Recording starts at 120 PLN per hour, with a sound engineer, full gear access, digital files and one revision included. The mixing and mastering price starts at 400 PLN per song. How many hours you need depends on the song and on how prepared you are: a well-rehearsed vocalist over a finished beat needs far less time than a band tracking every instrument. Tell us about your project and we’ll suggest a plan.

    To book vocal recording in Warsaw, use the contact form on this site, call +48 881 238 684 or send a message to @sanctum_sound_studio on Instagram.

    Questions and answers

    Can I record a song in Warsaw with you if I only have a beat or a demo?

    Yes. Bring your beat, instrumental or demo and we’ll record your vocals over it. If the song still needs work, we can also help with the arrangement and production.

    Is a sound engineer included in the hourly rate?

    Yes. A sound engineer runs every recording session. The rate, from 120 PLN per hour, also covers full access to the studio gear, digital files and one revision.

    What does the mixing and mastering price include?

    Mixing and mastering start at 400 PLN per song and include editing, unlimited revisions and help with preparing your release.

    Do you offer vocal tuning and drum editing?

    Yes, both. Vocal editing and tuning tidy up pitch and timing, and drum editing tightens the groove before the mix.
